import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final int LIMIT = 30;
    static final long MODUL = 1000000007;
    static long total;
    static int base;
    static int[][][] matrix = new int[65][35][35];
    static int[] remainders = new int[65];
    static int count = 0;
    static int[][] tempG = new int[35][35];
    static int[] resultA = new int[35];
    static int[] resultB = new int[35];

    static int subtractMod(int x, int y) {
        if (x < base) {
            return (x - y + base) % base;
        } else {
            return (x - y + base) % base;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        total = sc.nextLong();
        base = sc.nextInt();

        for (long t = total; t != 0; t /= base) {
            remainders[++count] = (int)(t % base);
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= base; ++i) {
            matrix[1][i][i] = 1;
        }
        for (int i = 0; i <= base; ++i) {
            matrix[1][0][i] = 1;
        }

        for (int step = 2; step <= count; ++step) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= base; ++j) {
                matrix[step][j][j] = 1;
            }
            for (int j = 0; j < base; ++j) {
                for (int a = 0; a <= base; ++a) {
                    for (int b = 0; b <= base; ++b) {
                        for (int c = 0; c <= base; ++c) {
                            tempG[a][c] = (int)((tempG[a][c] + (long)matrix[step - 1][subtractMod(a, j)][subtractMod(b, j)] * matrix[step][b][c]) % MODUL);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            for (int a = 0; a <= base; ++a) {
                for (int b = 0; b <= base; ++b) {
                    matrix[step][a][b] = tempG[a][b];
                    tempG[a][b] = 0;
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i <= base; ++i) {
            resultA[i] = 1;
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= count; ++i) {
            int sumS = 0;
            for (int j = i + 1; j <= count; ++j) {
                sumS = (sumS + remainders[j]) % base;
            }
            while (remainders[i] > 0) {
                int decVal = (sumS + remainders[i]) % base;
                for (int a = 0; a <= base; ++a) {
                    for (int b = 0; b <= base; ++b) {
                        resultB[b] = (int)((resultB[b] + (long)resultA[a] * matrix[i][subtractMod(a, decVal)][subtractMod(b, decVal)]) % MODUL);
                    }
                }
                for (int a = 0; a <= base; ++a) {
                    resultA[a] = resultB[a];
                    resultB[a] = 0;
                }
                remainders[i]--;
            }
        }

        System.out.println(resultA[base]);
        sc.close();
    }
}
